title: Evaluation preserved by binary conversion
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean circuit tree $c$ on $n$ variables, and every assignment $x :  br^n \to \{0,1\}$, the binary conversion of $c$ has the same evaluation at $x$ as $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
caveat: The statement refers to the binary conversion, but its defining construction is not included in the supplied definitions.
